slides.title: At all times
slides.body: Every vessel, every watch. Clear daylight and open ocean included.

slides.title: Sight and hearing
slides.body: Eyes and ears come first. Rule 5 names them before any equipment.

slides.title: All available means
slides.body: Radar, ARPA, AIS, VHF: whatever suits the conditions. They add to the look-out, they don't replace it.

slides.title: The point of it all
slides.body: A full appraisal of the situation and of the risk of collision.

slides.a: AIS shows every vessel around you.
slides.b: Many small craft don't transmit AIS. Look out of the window.

slides.question: What have you spotted by eye before radar?
slides.line: Practise COLREGs in the Learn tab.
